name: Lobed vase with underglaze cobalt blue decoration
material: Porcelain with underglaze cobalt blue decoration
summary: Underglaze blue-and-white designs reached their highest painterly quality during the reign of the Kangxi emperor (1662–1722). Porcelain decorators achieved a level of artistic and technical sophistication that rivaled that of professional painters. Blue-and-white porcelains in brilliant cobalt blue
